correctness.rationale: Lemma 1 follows from mirrored highest/lowest differing binary digits at the exact 2-adic valuation of the common progression difference. Lemma 2 uses the \(2^h\) center-bit gap at both endpoints of an odd-length palindrome layer. The gap recursion ensures all cross-layer first terms are below \(2^h\) but not \(3\), and the exact palindromic counting formula proves upper relative density at least \(1/3\). A standalone finite checker corroborates these steps but is not invoked as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The explicit arithmetic-progression-free subfamily with upper relative density at least \(1/3\) gives a negative solution to a published structural question.
